# Young-Seok Lee — Portfolio

> Ph.D. Candidate, Dept. of ECE, Seoul National University, co-advised by Prof. Sangwook Nam and Prof. Jungsuek Oh.
> Research areas: Wireless Power Transfer (WPT), RF Beamforming, Near-Field Beam Focusing, Target Detection, Indoor Localization, Space Solar Power.
> Lab: [Wave Fusion Lab.](http://wfl.snu.ac.kr)

The full machine-readable content — About me, Recent News, Press, Education, Publications, Awards & Honors, Research, Academic Service, Selected Coursework, Contact, with BibTeX for every paper — is available as a single markdown file:

- https://korbean-0311.github.io/llms-full.txt

## Pages

The site has 3 pages. "Academics" is ONE long page that holds the whole academic record in six sections; each section has its own anchor, so one fetch of academics.html returns everything below.

- [Home](https://korbean-0311.github.io/): About me (biography and research interests), Recent News, and Press (media coverage)
- [Academics](https://korbean-0311.github.io/academics.html): One long page with six sections —
  - [Education](https://korbean-0311.github.io/academics.html#education): Academic timeline (Ph.D. & M.S. at Seoul National University, B.S. at Korea University) with advisors, plus a collapsible academic-genealogy figure (doctoral advisor lineage)
  - [Publications](https://korbean-0311.github.io/academics.html#publications): A paper-count summary of selected IEEE journals (first- vs. co-authored), international journals (published and under review, with abstracts, keywords, BibTeX), international conferences, domestic conferences, and patents
  - [Awards & Honors](https://korbean-0311.github.io/academics.html#awards): Conference Awards (International), Conference Awards (Domestic), Conference Grants & Travel, Scholarships & Fellowships, Invited Papers, and Student Paper Competitions
  - [Research](https://korbean-0311.github.io/academics.html#research): Research projects with organizations, periods, and summaries (Graduate Student; Undergraduate Student Intern)
  - [Academic Service](https://korbean-0311.github.io/academics.html#academic-service): Journal Reviewer and Teaching Assistant (SNU)
  - [Selected Coursework](https://korbean-0311.github.io/academics.html#coursework): Graduate and Undergraduate courses
- [Contact](https://korbean-0311.github.io/contact.html): Lab, LinkedIn, and Location

(The former per-section URLs — education.html, publications.html, awards.html, research.html, others.html — redirect to the matching anchor on academics.html.)
